To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the dynamic characteristics of long-span railway continuous beam bridges are significantly influenced by the train-induced vibration and that the dynamic effects of a long-span railway continuous bridge are more complicated and severe than those of a long-span highway bridge.

the dynamic effects of the long-span railway continuous beam bridge can be divided into the following categories: (1) the dynamic effects of a long-span railway continuous-beam bridge under a moving vehicle can be divided into three parts: the dynamic effects caused by a vehicle moving on the bridge, the dynamic effects caused only by the bridge structure, and the dynamic effects of both the vehicle and the bridge structure.
the dynamic effects of the bridge are mainly influenced by the bridge length, the train speed and the train weight.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dynamic effects of a long-span railway continuous beam bridge.
the dynamic effects of the continuous railway bridge under moving train loads.
the dynamic characteristics of a long-span railway continuous beam bridge, including the dynamic characteristics of the bridge under different loading conditions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the dynamic response of the continuous beam bridge is significantly affected by the dynamic characteristics of the bridge, the dynamic characteristics of train, the dynamic characteristics and the dynamic characteristics of bridge–train coupling system.
the dynamic effects of the bridge are mainly affected by the dynamic characteristics of the vehicle, the bridge, and the vehicle-bridge interaction.
the dynamic effects of a long-span railway continuous beam bridge are significant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dynamic effect of a long-span continuous beam bridge with a large number of piers can be neglected.
the dynamic characteristics of a long-span railway continuous beam bridge are affected by its structural parameters, the train running on the bridge and the train-bridge interaction.
we have developed an experimental method for studying dynamic effects on a long-span railway continuous beam bridge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dynamic effects of long-span railway continuous beam bridges can be reduced to a great extent by using a proper bridge deck.
the dynamic response of a long-span railway continuous beam bridge is significantly affected by the bridge’s span length and the number of piers.

we have shown the importance of considering the dynamic effects in the design of the long-span continuous beam bridge, and the dynamic effects of the long-span bridge are mainly caused by the dynamic effects of its own structure.
